leftEvidence.title: The speaker laments what Adam’s sin brought

points.label: Shared consequence and announced reversal
points.left: The speaker wishes Adam had been restrained, addresses Adam directly, and says the evil fell not on him alone but on all who come from him.
points.right: Paul says all die in Adam and will be made alive in Christ, then orders resurrection, reign, enemies, death’s defeat, and final subjection.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Adam in 2 Esdras · later memory · 2 Esdras 7:116–118
points.right: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · 1 Corinthians 15:20–28

payload.posture: 2 Esdras laments evil reaching Adam’s descendants; Corinthians says all die in Adam and will be made alive in Christ.

rightEvidence.title: Death in Adam stands beside life in Christ

payload.tension: Both widen the consequence beyond Adam, while Corinthians carries the comparison toward resurrection and the end.
payload.title: The lament over Adam and life in Christ
